name: Art Of Evil
description:
About This Game

Art Of Evil is a roguelike horde survival game set in the medieval Dark Ages. Use magic to burn, smash, electrocute, freeze, explode or turn your enemies to stone in tense single player or exhilarating on-line coop with your friends. Face the unknown and annihilate tens of thousands of enemies and their bosses.

Features

  • Choose from multiple player classes with their own magic, hack and slash fighting and learning abilities

  • Cast dozens of magic perks which can interact to create unlimited synergies

  • Annihilate tens of thousands of enemies and hulking bosses while collecting tons of gems

  • Find treasures containing gold and unique powerups which immediately affect your battlefield

  • Use discovered gold to unlock new classes and maps

  • Play in tense single player or thrilling on-line coop with up to 4 friends

  • Work together with your friends and combine your chosen magic skills to survive

  • Play casually or in hardcore 30 minute runs or defeat end-of-game bosses to continue unlimited play

  • View detailed per-game and lifetime statistics which show your kills, perk usage stats and more
